Nach der Anmeldung setzt der Server ein:
After login the server sets a cookie. From now on the browser sends it with EVERY request – that is how the server knows who you are.
Look at what is inside the cookie "sitzung" (session).
Lies 1-login.txt. Das Cookie steht in de: Read 1-login.txt. The cookie is in the Set-Cookie: line after sitzung=
Der Wert sieht aus wie Buchstabensalat u: The value looks like jumbled letters and may end with =. That is typical for Base64.
Kopiere nur den Wert (bis vor das Semiko: Copy only the value (up to the semicolon) and decode it: echo VALUE | base64 -d
Lösung: grep Set-Cookie 1-login.txt | cu: Solution: grep Set-Cookie 1-login.txt | cut -d= -f2 | cut -d";" -f1 | base64 -d
Welche Rolle steht im Cookie?: Which role is in the cookie? (type the value exactly as it appears)
Im dekodierten Cookie gibt es ein Feld „: In the decoded cookie there is a field "rolle" (role).
Warum ist eine Rolle im Cookie gefährlic: Why is a role in the cookie dangerous if the server simply believes it?
Das Cookie liegt beim Nutzer – er kann e: The cookie is with the user – they can change it. The server has to check and store permissions itself.
Cookies sind immer verschlüsselt, also i: Cookies are always encrypted, so it does not matter.
Wo liegt das Cookie, und wer kann es bea: Where is the cookie stored, and who can edit it?
Base64 ist keine Verschlüsselung – du ha: Base64 is not encryption – you just read it yourself.
Welche Schutz-Eigenschaft fehlt dem Cook: Which protective attribute is the cookie missing that keeps JavaScript from reading it?
Cookies können Zusatz-Eigenschaften habe: Cookies can have extra attributes after semicolons. Here there is only Path=/.
Es gibt eine Eigenschaft, die JavaScript: There is an attribute that forbids JavaScript to access the cookie (important against XSS).
Lösung: HttpOnly (außerdem fehlt Secure: Solution: HttpOnly (Secure is missing too – send only over HTTPS)
Moderne Shops laden Produkte per API als:
Modern shops load products through an API as JSON. The website then shows only part of it – name and price.
But what does the server really send?
Welches Feld verrät, was der Shop selbst: Which field reveals what the shop itself pays for a product? (type the field name)
Neben name und preis stehen Felder, die: Next to name and preis (price) there are fields that customers should never see.
Nicht jedes Produkt hat dieselben Felder: Not every product has the same fields. One has an extra internal field.
grep sucht in der Datei nach einem Wort: grep searches the file for a word – e.g. for "intern" or for KLY.
Wie behebt man das richtig?: How do you fix this properly?
Der Server schickt nur die Felder, die d: The server sends only the fields the page really needs.
Alles, was beim Browser ankommt, kann ma: Everything that reaches the browser can be read – whether it is shown or not.
Im Protokoll siehst du Anfragen eines an: In the log you see requests from a logged-in customer. Pay attention to WHO is logged in and WHOSE data comes back.
Welche andere Kundin bekommt Seppi bei B: Which other customer does Seppi get to see for order 1042? (name)
cat 3-bestellungen.log – die erste Zeile: cat 3-bestellungen.log – the first line says who is logged in.
Vergleiche bei jeder Antwort das Feld „k: For every response, compare the field "kunde" (customer) with the logged-in user.
Was fehlt auf dem Server?: What is missing on the server?
Die Prüfung, ob die angefragte Bestellun: The check whether the requested order belongs to the logged-in customer.
A better web server than nginx.
Längere Bestellnummern – dann errät sie: Longer order numbers – then nobody guesses them.
Seppi hat nur die Zahl in der Adresse um: Seppi only increased the number in the address by 1.
Der Fachbegriff: fehlende Zugriffskontro: The technical term: Broken Access Control (number 1 in the OWASP Top 10).
Du entdeckst so etwas zufällig bei einem: You discover something like this by accident in a real shop. What is right?
Nicht weiter ausprobieren, keine fremden: Stop trying, do not fetch other people’s data – inform the owner responsibly.
Alle Bestellungen herunterladen, um es z: Download all orders to prove it.
Ohne Erlaubnis ist jeder weitere Abruf f: Without permission, every further access to other people’s data is not allowed – even "just for testing".
